{{DISPLAYTITLE:Resonance}}

'''Resonance''' (RES) gives eligible spells a chance to cast a second time immediately. The repeated cast costs no mana and uses its own hit, resistance, critical, and damage rolls.

== Quick summary ==
* Each point of effective Resonance gives a 1% chance to repeat an eligible spell, up to a guaranteed repeat at 100 RES.
* Direct-damage spells, targeted area spells, point-blank area spells, and healing spells can resonate unless the spell is specifically excluded.
* Damage-over-time and other status-effect spells cannot resonate.
* An ordinary resonated direct-damage spell uses 30% of its normal base component, then recalculates the full [[Stats#Intelligence|Intelligence]] and [[Proficiencies|Arcanism]] contribution.
* Targeted area and point-blank area spells repeat at full damage.
* Healing spells use 50% of their base healing on the repeated cast, then recalculate their full [[Stats#Wisdom|Wisdom]] and [[Proficiencies|Restoration]] contribution.

== Resonance chance ==

The game rolls an integer from 0 through 99 after an eligible spell resolves. The spell resonates when the roll is lower than the caster's effective RES:

:<math display="block">\Pr(\text{resonance})=\min\left(\frac{R}{100},1\right),</math>

where <math>R</math> is effective Resonance.

{| class="wikitable"
! Effective RES !! Resonance chance
|-
| 1 || 1%
|-
| 25 || 25%
|-
| 50 || 50%
|-
| 99 || 99%
|-
| 100 or more || 100%
|}

Effective Resonance is the rounded total of base Resonance, equipment Resonance, and temporary Resonance effects after the active stance multiplier is applied. All current stances use a Resonance multiplier of 1.

A resonance can occur even when the original spell is resisted. An area spell
can also resonate after hitting no targets. The repeated cast performs a new
resistance roll.

== Repeated cast ==

A successful resonance starts a second cast of the same spell. The repeated cast:

* costs no mana
* resolves after a 1.1-unit internal recast timer
* preserves the original {{AbilityLink|Chant Control}} scaling
* can be created even when the original cast dealt no damage
* rolls critical effects and target resistance independently

The internal recast timer advances at 60 units per second. A 1.1-unit timer is nominally 0.018 seconds, but the spell can resolve only on a frame update. At 60 frames per second, it therefore resolves on the second frame, approximately 0.033 seconds after the resonance. A resonating spell proc uses a 1-unit timer, nominally 0.017 seconds.

Resonance has a per-character cooldown. Most resonances set it to approximately one second. A resonating direct-damage weapon proc sets it to approximately 0.08 seconds. The cooldown normally prevents the repeated cast from immediately resonating again.

== Eligible spells ==

Eligibility is based on the spell type.

{| class="wikitable"
! Spell type !! Can resonate? !! Repeated effect
|-
| Direct damage || Yes || Reduced direct-damage base, then normal scaling
|-
| Targeted area damage || Yes || Full normal damage
|-
| Point-blank area damage || Yes || Full normal damage
|-
| Health healing || Yes || Half base healing, then normal scaling
|-
| Mana restoration and cleanse effects classified as healing || Yes || Full normal effect
|-
| Damage over time and other status effects || No || Not applicable
|-
| Beneficial buffs || No || Not applicable
|-
| Miscellaneous spells || No || Not applicable
|-
| Pet summons || No || Not applicable
|}

Weapon, bow, wand, and bracer procs use the same eligibility rules. A proc can resonate when the spell produced by the proc belongs to an eligible type.

=== Explicit exclusions ===

The following spells belong to an otherwise eligible type but are specifically prevented from resonating:

'''Reaver damage spells'''
* {{AbilityLink|Mutual Ache}}
* {{AbilityLink|Mutual Pain}}
* {{AbilityLink|Mutual Torment}}
* {{AbilityLink|Mutual Doom}}

'''Reaver mana-restoration spells'''
* {{AbilityLink|Dark Ritual}}
* {{AbilityLink|Dark Pact}}
* {{AbilityLink|Dark Sacrifice}}
* {{AbilityLink|Emit Vitae}}

All current targeted area and point-blank area damage spells are eligible.

== Direct-damage formula ==

A resonated direct-damage spell uses 30% of the normal base spell component. Its [[Stats#Intelligence|Intelligence]] and [[Proficiencies|Arcanism]] contribution is then calculated normally.

Let:
* <math>B</math> be the rounded spell base after {{AbilityLink|Chant Control}} and stance spell-damage modifiers
* <math>L</math> be character level
* <math>I</math> be current [[Stats#Intelligence|Intelligence]]
* <math>A</math> be effective [[Proficiencies|Arcanism]] divided by 100
* <math>X</math> be the base component used by the current cast

The pre-resistance direct-damage calculation is:

:<math display="block">D=\operatorname{round}\left(X+\operatorname{round}\left(\frac{L}{8}A(3I+X)\right)\right).</math>

For an ordinary cast:

:<math display="block">X=B.</math>

For an ordinary resonated cast:

:<math display="block">X=0.30B.</math>

The <math>3I</math> term retains its full value, so [[Stats#Intelligence|Intelligence]] and [[Proficiencies|Arcanism]] can make the repeated hit substantially larger than 30% of the original hit.

After this calculation, the repeated cast independently applies the critical blast from {{AbilityLink|Arcane Proficiency}}, [[Ascension Skills#Arcanist|Arcane Mastery]], the normal damage cap, and target resistance or mitigation.

== Area damage ==

Targeted area and point-blank area spells repeat their full normal damage calculation. Each target receives another independent resistance roll.

A resonated area spell can therefore deal full normal damage again to every eligible target.

== Healing and mana restoration ==

Health-healing spells can resonate. The repeated heal uses 50% of the spell's base HP value, then applies the full [[Stats#Wisdom|Wisdom]] and [[Proficiencies|Restoration]] contribution. [[Ascension Skills#Druid|Critical Healing]] and other healing bonuses are rolled normally.

The full [[Stats#Wisdom|Wisdom]] and [[Proficiencies|Restoration]] contribution is added after the base HP value is halved, so the repeated heal can exceed half of the original heal.

Mana-restoration spells and cleanse-style effects classified as healing repeat their full normal effect. The four excluded Reaver mana-restoration spells listed above cannot resonate.

== Roaring Echoes ==

The repeat chance is capped at 100%. Resonance above 100 instead improves resonated direct-damage spells through the [[Ascension Skills#Arcanist|Arcanist ascension Roaring Echoes]].

On a resonated direct-damage spell, Roaring Echoes has a 30% activation chance per ascension rank:

{| class="wikitable"
! Roaring Echoes rank !! Activation chance
|-
| 1 || 30%
|-
| 2 || 60%
|-
| 3 || 90%
|}

When Roaring Echoes activates at more than 100 RES, it replaces the ordinary 30% base component with:

:<math display="block">X=\frac{R}{100}B.</math>

Examples:

{| class="wikitable"
! Effective RES !! Base component when Roaring Echoes activates
|-
| 110 || 110% of the normal base
|-
| 125 || 125% of the normal base
|-
| 150 || 150% of the normal base
|}

The normal [[Stats#Intelligence|Intelligence]] and [[Proficiencies|Arcanism]] contribution is then calculated from the enhanced base.

== Arcane Recovery ==

{{AbilityLink|Arcane Recovery}} is available to [[Arcanist|Arcanists]] at level 12 and to [[Druid|Druids]] and [[Stormcaller|Stormcallers]] at level 20. When a spell resonates, Arcane Recovery restores a random 15% through 65% of that spell's mana cost, up to the caster's maximum mana.

{{AbilityLink|Arcane Recovery}} uses the listed mana cost of the resonating spell. A proc with a nonzero listed mana cost can therefore grant mana through Arcane Recovery.
